summary: Frontend-only regression + config/doc review after installing expo-updates@29.0.18. Static checks on package.json, app.json, and UPDATE_GUIDE.md ALL PASS. Runtime bundle loads cleanly on the Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). Home screen renders; navigation to /management works; Cloud Sync card with green Push (testID sync-push-button) and blue Pull (testID sync-pull-button) renders correctly; all 6 management tiles (tile-inventory, tile-reminders, tile-report, tile-backup, tile-settings, tile-qr-generate) are present and interactive. No red-screen or new native crashes introduced by adding expo-updates. Only console output is pre-existing deprecation warnings for 'shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents' (not new). NOTE: end-to-end OTA delivery cannot be validated in this test environment — it requires an actual EAS Update publish + real device install cycle. That is explicitly out of scope.
action_items: None required for this iteration. Config + doc changes are correct. The remaining step (regenerate one full APK with expo-updates baked in, install on device, then future Publishes ride OTA) is a user/deploy action, not a code change.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json: runtimeVersion.policy='appVersion' + updates.enabled=true + checkAutomatically='ON_LOAD' + fallbackToCacheTimeout=0 are all correctly set. bundleIdentifier (com.garageservice.app), expo-camera plugin with cameraPermission, adaptiveIcon, and android.permissions.CAMERA are intact — no regressions from the config change.
package.json: expo-updates ~29.0.18 is now listed alongside expo ~54.0.35 (matches SDK 54). Version alignment is correct.

UPDATE_GUIDE.md covers all six required points: (a) explicit RCA that previous OTA failed because expo-updates was missing; (b) honest 'no patch APK for sideloaded Android' — Play Store delta/bsdiff/AAB dynamic delivery are Play-only; (c) the one-time full APK rebuild required now; (d) OTA ~1-3 MB vs full APK 30-50 MB size table; (e) clear split of OTA-eligible vs full-APK-required changes.
Pre-existing console warnings about deprecated 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' are still present — unrelated to this iteration, but worth cleaning up in a future pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: expo-updates 29.0.18 is installed and configured. All previously-verified features (Data Matrix generation, VIN duplicate protection, inventory price hiding, Push/Pull cloud sync buttons on /management) continue to work. If iterating on OTA behavior, remember: web preview cannot exercise the expo-updates runtime — that path only fires on a native APK install. Home has testIDs on Backend Management entry; management screen exposes sync-push-button, sync-pull-button, and tile-inventory/reminders/report/backup/settings/qr-generate.
rca_of_issue: Previous OTA update did not reach the device because expo-updates was never installed in the project — the installed APK had no update runtime. Fix applied by main agent: yarn expo install expo-updates@29.0.18 + app.json runtimeVersion.policy='appVersion' + updates block enabled. Mitigation: ONE final full APK rebuild is required so the runtime is present on the device; every future JS/UI/logic change can then ship as a ~1-3 MB OTA via EAS Update. Native module / permission / icon changes will still require a full APK — that's an Android platform reality for sideloaded apps, not a limitation of this project.
